name: File Edits
description: Tabbed file viewer with multiple viewer types per tab. V1.1: per-tab viewer toggle (→ Diff / → Markdown) floats in the top-right of the content pane when the file has more than one applicable viewer. See docs/files-applet-v1.1.md.

agentUsage.purpose: Tabbed file viewer with per-tab viewer switching. Default viewer is markdown for .md files and diff for everything else. A floating button in the top-right of the content pane toggles between viewers when more than one applies to the file.
